crossRefs.note: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is…
you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the…
Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give…
Nevertheless, I will not do it in your days, for David your father’s sake; but I will tear it out of your son’s hand.
Our eyes still fail, looking in vain for our help. In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save.

translations.web: He who denounces his friends for plunder, Even the eyes of his children will fail.
translations.bsb: If a man denounces his friends for a price, the eyes of his children will fail.
translations.kjv: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
translations.asv: He that denounceth his friends for a prey, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.
